name: PREP / 进入前准备
basis: C22 M0；总量服从C23 T182；远程设计分配
sensitivity: 票务/信息确认、同行者准备、运营状态

name: ARRIVAL / 云坛口服务—北站
slope_metric: DESIGN TEST GRADE, NOT SITE SLOPE
basis: A03/C22关系；坡度无来源，作为设计敏感性测试
sensitivity: 到达模式、排队、路面、台阶/无障碍实际关系
future_field_correction: 路线长度+高程/GPS+净宽实测

name: CROSS-RIVER CABLE / 去程
slope_metric: 156/1056=14.8% CHORD VERTICAL RATIO; NOT TERRAIN GRADE
basis: A04+A05：索道1056m、高差156m；时间含候乘/进出站的远程设计缓冲
sensitivity: 实际运行速度、停机/排队、居民与游客共用
future_field_correction: 站到站实测运行+排队分布

name: SOUTH WALK A / 南站—核心景观
slope_metric: DESIGN TEST GRADE, NOT SITE SLOPE
basis: A01/A02仅支持多分支网络；坡度/长度不支持，故仅做测试带
sensitivity: 支路选择、台阶、停看频率、真实高差
future_field_correction: 逐段长度/高程/台阶数/GPS轨迹

name: SOUTH WALK B / 分支—回环阅读
slope_metric: DESIGN TEST GRADE, NOT SITE SLOPE
basis: A01/A02多分支/回环；十三印为可选阅读层
sensitivity: 阅读选择、拥挤、支路开放、休息
future_field_correction: 真实支路拓扑+停留时间+坡度

name: SOUTH WALK C / 回收—返程方向
slope_metric: DESIGN TEST GRADE, NOT SITE SLOPE
sensitivity: 返程识别、体力、关闭支路
future_field_correction: 返程真实最短路径+夜间/雨后测试

name: OBSERVE / READ / RECOVER
slope_metric: LOCAL CIRCULATION TEST, NOT SITE SLOPE
basis: C22 M4 CONDITIONAL；R06含恢复角色但Field Geometry Open
sensitivity: 停留强度、座靠需求、天气、可达性
future_field_correction: 行为观察+停留计时+可达性审核

name: WITHDRAW / 收束
sensitivity: 关闭/退化状态、返程提示可见性
future_field_correction: 路线决策点可读性测试

name: CABLE RETURN / 返程
slope_metric: -156/1056=-14.8% CHORD VERTICAL RATIO; NOT TERRAIN GRADE
sensitivity: 运营状态、排队、居民优先/共用逻辑

name: EXIT / MEMORY
slope_metric: DESIGN TEST GRADE, NOT SITE SLOPE
sensitivity: 出口位置、交通接驳、纸本领取
